# Challenge the Footage — full agent brief

> Document templates for challenging surveillance evidence. **Not legal advice.** Attorney review required before filing.

## Problem

No major surveillance vendor (Flock Safety, Axon, Motorola/Vigilant, Genetec, Verkada) publicly documents cryptographic integrity controls (hash-at-capture in camera HSE, Merkle chaining, external immutable anchoring). Industry ALPR misidentification ~10%. FOIA-derived Flock logs show ~84% of queries without case numbers. Institute for Justice has documented wrongful stops and officer romantic-tracking abuse.

## Four documents generated

1. **FRE 901 motion in limine** — authentication / chain of custody
2. **FRE 702 / Daubert motion** — reliability; proposed ≤0.1% error floor
3. **Fourth Amendment suppression** — undocumented / abusive ALPR access
4. **§ 1983 demand letter** — civil damages for wrongful stop/detention

## Pricing & access

- Free first generation per Google account
- $9 per additional generation (Stripe via ClawQL payments — credit card only)
- Public defenders: free unlimited — email pd@challengethefootage.com
- Evidence recording is free to capture; users never need a crypto wallet

## API

See [openapi.json](https://challengethefootage.com/openapi.json). Authenticated `/api/*` routes require `Authorization: Bearer <Google ID token>` (or local test auth when enabled).

### Generate

`POST /api/generate` body includes `tosAccepted: true`, `vendor` (`flock|axon|motorola|genetec|verkada|custom`), case fields, and optional fact narratives. Returns `{ sessionId, docs: { motion, accuracy, access, civil } }`.

### Evidence

- `POST /api/evidence/secure` — store hashes / Merkle package for a recording; ClawQL anchors independently behind the scenes
- `GET /api/evidence/sessions` — list evidence for the signed-in account
- `GET /api/evidence/verify/{id}` — public verification status (no wallet UX)

## Integrity standards (for vendors / cities)

## Evidence capture

Primary UX: [Evidence on Challenge the Footage](https://challengethefootage.com/evidence.html) (in-browser record + secure). Optional native module: `witness/` in the open-source repo — same product account, deep-link back with `?witnessSession=`.
